extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to demonstrate the issue by searching the supplied files for any way a single independent unit could enter the t-test more than once: I checked every bog_id in data/input.csv for duplicates (all 12 are distinct), checked the catchment column for a hidden grouping that could make two rows the same unit (all 12 catchments are distinct, matching the description that each catchment holds exactly one bog), traced workflow/analysis.py to confirm each CSV row contributes exactly one value to exactly one group with no row duplication, resampling, or re-reading of the file, and verified the code would raise an error on any repeated identifier. I also recomputed the group means, difference, t-statistic, and p-value from the raw rows and matched them to the report, confirming the test used exactly the 12 unique-unit rows. No path to repeated-unit entry was found, so the falsification attempt failed and the no-issue verdict stands.
